searchByKeyOrUser: Search by access key ID or username...

only2FAGlobalAdmins: This user has 2FA enabled. Only global administrators can disable it.
twoFAStatusRestricted: Only the user or a global administrator can view this 2FA status.
lastAdminInTenant: Every tenant must have at least one admin. This is the last admin in the tenant.
aboutToDeleteKey: You are about to delete the access key
passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
twoFADisabledDesc: Two-factor authentication has been disabled for this user.
regenerateCodesConfirm: This will invalidate all existing backup codes and generate new ones. Continue?
codesRegeneratedDesc: Your new backup codes are ready. Please save them in a secure location.
userNotFoundDesc: The requested user does not exist.
adminResetPasswordInfo: As an admin, you can reset this user's password without knowing their current password.
createKeyDesc: Create an access key to allow programmatic access to this user's resources.
onlyAdminsChangeRoles: Only administrators can change user roles.
cannotChangeOwnRole: You cannot change your own role.
accessKeyInfoMsg: An access key and secret key pair will be automatically generated for this user.
secretKeyOnceMsg: The secret key will only be displayed once after creation. Make sure to copy and store it in a safe place.
secretKeyWarning: This is the only time the secret key will be displayed. Copy and store it in a safe place before closing this window.
disable2FAConfirmSelf: Are you sure you want to disable 2FA? This will make your account less secure.
disable2FAConfirmOther: Are you sure you want to disable 2FA for this user? This will make their account less secure.
notInAnyGroup: This user is not a member of any group.
notInAnyGroupSelf: You are not a member of any group.
alreadyInAllGroups: This user is already in all available groups.
capabilitiesDesc: Service-level permissions for this user. Toggles set an explicit override on top of the role defaults.
roleCapabilitiesDesc: Configure which capabilities each role grants by default. Changes apply to all users with that role immediately.
roleCapabilitiesGlobalWarning: These settings apply globally to all tenants. Per-user overrides set by tenant admins take precedence over role defaults.
roleCapabilitiesAdminNote: The admin role always has all capabilities and cannot be restricted here.
stsIssuedWarning: Copy them now. The secret and session token are shown only once.
stsRevokeMessage: Applications using these credentials will lose access immediately.
stsDesc: Short-lived S3 credentials that carry your own permissions and expire automatically. Use them so applications never hold your permanent keys.
stsNoSessionsDesc: Issue temporary credentials to see them listed here.
stsPolicyToggle: Restrict this credential with a policy
stsPolicyHelp: An optional policy that can only narrow the credential: a session never gets more than your own permissions. Actions and resources accept wildcards; Condition is not supported yet.
iamDesc: Managed policies and roles. The same entities the AWS IAM API manages.
iamScopeNote: A policy attached to an existing user can only restrict what that user could already do. Only identities created through the IAM API are granted permissions by their policies.
iamPolicyDocumentHint: Effect, Action and Resource with AWS wildcards. Condition is not supported and is rejected on save.
iamTrustPolicyHint: Decides who may assume this role. A Principal is required - a role with no trust policy can be assumed by nobody.
iamRoleNoPolicies: no policies - this role can do nothing
iamNoPoliciesDesc: Managed policies define what an identity may do. Built-in ones appear here too.
iamNoRolesDesc: A role is an identity an application assumes to get exactly the permissions the role grants.
permissionsPickUserHint: Pick a user to see and change what they can do.
permissionsDesc: Tick what this user may do. A whole group in one click, or one action at a time.
permissionsEverywhereHint: Applies to every bucket, and to the actions that belong to no bucket.
permissionsBucketHint: Applies only to this bucket and the objects in it.
iamTrustPolicyOptionalHint: Optional. Leave empty for a role you assign to users; fill it in only for a role applications assume with AssumeRole.
policyBuilderHint: Tick the permissions. Add a bucket to grant different permissions on it.
